cues: In nineteen eleven, Kamerlingh Onnes cooled mercury with liquid helium, and found something astonishing.
At four point two kelvin, its resistance suddenly vanished.
Zero, as far as any instrument can tell.
That sharp temperature is the critical temperature, T c.
text: In nineteen eleven, Kamerlingh Onnes cooled mercury with liquid helium, and found something astonishing. At four point two kelvin, its resistance suddenly vanished. Not very small. Zero, as far as any instrument can tell. That sharp temperature is the critical temperature, T c.
